findings.description: Independently enumerated the authoritative Samueli ECE directory (9 pages, 103 unique people) and the joint-ece directory (2 pages, 13 people, all also on the main ECE list); all 103 directory people are required records, no directory person is missing from the brief and no brief person is missing from the directory. The ECE and joint directories were re-fetched live on 2026-11-23 and list the same people with the same department categories as the pinned captures. Coverage is complete across the Samueli directories.

ee.ucla.edu/albertl-faculty is an older 2020-2021 supporting page (it carries notices such as "joining the ECE Dept. July 2021"). It additionally lists Alyson Fletcher, Diana Huffaker, Tatsuo Itoh, Fabien Scalzo, Jason Speyer, Oscar Stafsudd, Dwight Streit and King-Ning Tu, none of whom is on the current Samueli ECE or joint-ece directories. The current Samueli directories are authoritative, so these names are not counted and the older page is not treated as confirmation of any current appointment. The ee.ucla.edu emeriti page adds no names beyond the Samueli emeriti-ece category.

Ingrid Verbauwhede: listed on the authoritative Samueli ECE directory (category ece only) with profile title Professor and an ee.ucla.edu email; absent from the adjunct, lecturer, joint and emeriti lists and from the ee.ucla.edu emeriti page. Classified included/regular. Her directory card carries no core-ece sub-category, as for Bahman Gharesifard, and the card is dated 2018.

Zachary Taylor: listed on the authoritative Samueli ECE directory (category ece only) with profile title Professor; absent from adjunct, lecturer, joint and emeriti lists. His profile email is a seas.ucla.edu address (not ee.ucla.edu). Classified included/regular on the official ECE listing; no core-ece sub-category on the card.

Pedram Khalili: listed on the authoritative Samueli ECE directory (category ece only) with profile title Professor, a UCLA office and Device Research Laboratory link; absent from adjunct, lecturer, joint and emeriti lists. His profile email is a ucla.edu address (not ee.ucla.edu). Classified included/regular on the official ECE listing; no core-ece sub-category on the card.

Ezio Biglieri: listed on the authoritative Samueli ECE directory (category ece only) with profile title Professor and an ee.ucla.edu email; absent from adjunct, lecturer, joint and emeriti lists and from the ee.ucla.edu emeriti page. Classified included/regular on the official ECE listing; no core-ece sub-category on the card.

Corey Arnold: Samueli ECE directory categories affiliate-ece, ece, be, joint-be; profile title Professor (Bioengineering home). The official ECE affiliate-ece designation for a professor is an affiliate/below-the-line appointment, so included/affiliate_professor.

Douglas Lichtman: listed on the official joint-ece directory with title Professor of Law; classified included/joint_secondary on the explicit official joint ECE listing, with no regular-versus-courtesy subtype established.
Dan Goebel appears on the joint-ece list but his official title is Adjunct Professor (categories adjunct-ece, adjunct-mae, joint-ece, mae); the adjunct title governs and he is excluded.
